description.full_text: The image shows an ancient script on a wooden tablet with a handle, displayed against a textured fabric background. The script consists of intricate, vertically arranged text in an unfamiliar language. The atmosphere is historical and scholarly, suggesting a focus on preserving and studying ancient writings. Watermarks with the text "alamy" are visible across the image.
